service.name: Career strategy call
service.description: One hour to work out your next move, and leave with a written 90-day plan.
service.descriptionHtml:
Stuck between staying and leaving, or applying everywhere and hearing nothing back? In one hour we work out what you actually want next, and what's in the way.

Before the call I read your profile and the answers you give below, so we start on the real question, not your CV.

Who it's for: people a few years into their career who want a promotion, a switch, or a way back in after time off.
highlights: A written 90-day plan in your inbox the same evening
Notes on your profile and the one change that matters most
Three people or teams worth reaching out to, and what to say
A follow-up email two weeks later to check how it's going

location.label: Video call, link in your confirmation

cover.alt: A printed 90-day plan with three milestones circled

service.cutoffText: Move or cancel for a full refund up to 24 hours before.

confirmationMessage: Your plan template is attached. Fill in the first page if you have ten minutes before we talk.
